Untimed puzzle games in the browser

Which NoCharge puzzles have no countdown, what untimed really changes, and the honest caveats about session length and difficulty.

By NoCharge Editorial·Reviewed by NoCharge Editorial·Published August 27, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read
Check the current platform.

Use the public pages behind this explanation.

Open the ArcadeReview PrivacyKeyboard-only play notes

Bottom line: “Untimed” means there is no countdown in that game’s current rules. It does not mean a puzzle has no loss condition, that every title is untimed, or that a session will take a particular length.

Read the current game page

An older version of this article listed a smaller catalog and mixed historic controls with current language. Do not use that list, its session estimates, or its Color Flip description as a current V2 inventory. The Arcade page for each game is the source for today’s timer, modes, controls, and end conditions.

Two current examples

Word Search has no countdown: the current eight-by-eight puzzle ends when its four listed words have been found. Word Tile Rush is timed: its 90-second counter starts after the first tile selection, and the run can also end when the rising grid reaches the top.

Color Flip is not the old timed visual-board game described in earlier copy. Its current Trail session and Color cycle modes share a ten-target sequence and have no countdown.

Untimed does not mean consequence-free

A game without a clock can still have a move count, an incorrect-entry message, a full-board loss, or a terminal rule. Check the page’s stated objective rather than inferring that “no timer” means “no way to lose.”

Choose by the pressure you want

If you want no countdown, confirm that the selected game’s live page says so. If you prefer a timed challenge, check the exact timer and what starts it. The current source does not publish one verified percentage of the entire Arcade that is “untimed or both.”

For the current word-game contrast, see Word Tile Rush vs Word Search.
